set.body:
Outcome

Replace the monolithic dataset bridge with direct construction of core evidence and metadata columns.

Acceptance

- General SampleId, ItemId, BlockId, SampleOrigin, and metadata semantics have one owner.
- Dataset reading does not define a second experiment table algebra.
- Feature and sample identity survive conversion exactly.
- The mvpa-dataset artifact and compatibility types are deleted.
set.title: P6.2: absorb mvpa-dataset as exact source and axis construction
